scope: Offline retained owner APK/source/receipt evidence. Original EOL dictionary recovery and exact manual-cache locator; no new car or factory-server access.

newFindings.claim: afterRunRes can preserve a subset of formatted DTC plus factory-description pairs, not only generic display text.
chain: MatchUtils.lambda$log1902$9 reads raw numeric code and finds Attach.Dtc.getCode equality, then gets getDesc; missing description becomes empty string.
It formats the code using its own P/C/B/U transformation, appends code/status/description to system output, and adds "%s - %s" to CaseStatus.troubleCodes.

ScriptRunCompleteManager selects non-success systems and cases whose code is not1000; each troubleCodes string becomes SystemResult.itemDesc, name is systemId. Without troubleCodes it stores caseName instead.

complete schedules persistence only when afterDoneEnterSuperLowPower is true and status is not USER_CANCEL, REMOTE_CANCEL or STRATEGY_FAIL; the delayed handler saves RunResultModelData before enterLowPower.

ScriptResultDao serializes this model into afterRunRes through SpUtils. runCommandData is transient; the persisted name/itemDesc pair has no separate script tuple, ECU address, software code or raw status.
This is a short-lived continuation cache: it is cleared on low-power failure or the20-second still-alive callback, on result-close confirmation, and when a restored display increments showTime to>=3.
newFindings.qualification: Source and original DEX proof, not a recovered vehicle record. Only failures that reached this path and were not suppressed by the MATCH_WHITES filter can appear. Generic case labels can coexist. Text is candidate historical evidence until independently joined to original script/ECU/software; stock formatting is not qualification of format01 for this car.

newFindings.claim: RUNNING_TASK and afterRunRes share device-protected package preferences. The former has downloadCommand.scriptList selection identities; station sessions do not add a dictionary.
newFindings.qualification: These paths were already source-derived in earlier research. This pass refines what each field can recover; it is not a newly observed cache. The prior approved receipt checked only RUNNING_TASK and reported key_missing in a65-byte preferences file; it did not project afterRunRes. No reason to infer current contents or to repeat acquisition without changed evidence.

newFindings.claim: ManualRunnable writes the package manifest to classify_cache.db/classify; media_cache.db/media_cache maps the exact URL to the downloaded local file and state.
newFindings.qualification: The failed JADX queryByPage stub was closed with original classes.dex disassembly. queryByPage filters vin and page, orders _id_id, and reconstructs ZipInfo in MANUAL and SANBAO branches. These are manual packages, not demonstrated diagnostic scenarios or ECU-wide DTC dictionaries.

newFindings.claim: LocalPathUtil strips non-word characters from the final raw URL substring. ManualFragment.getUnZipFolder then removes exactly the last3 characters of the absolute downloaded filename.
newFindings.qualification: Confirmed original DEX at code_item0x3474f8. It does not parse an extension or strip a query first; do not invent a .zip path. Prefer actual persisted targetFile and media local_path. getLocalPath can initiate a download and the DB singleton opens a writable database, so invoking the app/helper is not an inspection-only operation.

newFindings.claim: BydEolLog and manual MLog send inspected messages to android.util.Log. This call chain does not establish a durable app-owned report archive.
newFindings.qualification: Four retained logs were searched for8 new manual-related markers; zero matches. This says nothing about current private storage, arbitrary-name files or other historical logs.

manualDbJoin.completionPredicate: media_cache.state==1 AND actual local_path exists; DB state alone is insufficient
manualDbJoin.pathContext: MApp and both DB constructors use ordinary applicationContext; manifest does not opt into defaultToDeviceProtectedStorage. User0 CE absolute paths are platform-layout inferences, not observed paths.
manualDbJoin.cacheFallback: existing externalCacheDir else internal getCacheDir; do not assume one guaranteed location
manualDbJoin.privacy: VIN, raw URLs with query/auth/userinfo, arbitrary non-package rows and unfiltered preference/header fields must not enter a retained projection. Exact URL join can be performed in memory before redaction.
manualDbJoin.consistency: A future SQLite acquisition needs a consistent read snapshot or matching WAL state. No live DB copy or projection was attempted.

verification.dexAddressConvention: DEX code_item and instruction file offsets in each named DEX member; no virtual-address rebase. Printed raw instruction bytes are compared directly.

nextUsefulEvidence: An already existing original script with station/code/version and ECU/software applicability remains the primary dictionary source.
If a legitimate historical afterRunRes value is available, retain name/itemDesc as historical candidates with provenance; do not infer a full dictionary or present fault state.

A consistent pair of manual DB projections can locate the exact retained archive/HTML directory. Inspect an existing package before deciding whether it contains diagnostic information; do not launch a download merely to fill caches.
unchangedGaps: No new ECM/BMS/drive factory DTC definitions. Six BMS heading misses, P2BAE00 conflict, format01 qualification and warning-to-DTC relation remain open.
